body: ADVISOR CORRECTION (2026-11-02 20:00 MST), TASK-2772. My 19:25 ruling granting lanes read-write on the shared sccache dir is WITHDRAWN. A contained lane writing the shared sccache can plant a poisoned artifact that the host and other seats later reuse: the same class as BUG-2418, and exactly what BUG-2169 ruling O2 forbids. Final ruling: NO sandbox grant for sccache anywhere (seat clones or other lanes). Non-seat lanes get ONLY the cargo-slot dir pair. The gate wrapper detects that sccache is unusable (a refused socket or dir) once and falls back to RUSTC_WRAPPER= with a one-line note. Seat clones stay on O2 unchanged. The lane's reading of O2 is correct; keep it.
subject: RULING: drop the sccache dir; slots + RUSTC_WRAPPER= fallback only
